title: Add a record from the chat
summary: A tool: type its word, what it was and how much, and a row is added to your table, with a sentence back.
description: A tool for your team, used from the chat on the web, the phone app, WhatsApp, Telegram and Slack. Type its word with what it was and an amount ("/add-sale 2 bags of rice 45000") and a row is added to your table, with a sentence back saying so. People see what will be added and say yes first. It is fixed to one table, with its own name: what, amount and note. Taskiem makes the table if it does not exist. Choose the word it is called by when you install it; if that word is taken, it gets the next free one (add-sale-2) and says so.

params.name: roles
params.title: Who can use it
params.description: The roles whose people may use it from the chat; owners always may. It reads your table, so keep it to those who may see it.

params.description: The table rows are added to. Taskiem makes it if it does not exist.
